summary.name: Boords
summary.one_liner: Boords is a web-based storyboard and pre-production tool for scripts, storyboards and animatics, with client review by share link and version approval.
use_cases: Sharing storyboards with clients for feedback and sign-off
Building animatics with voiceover before shooting
Generating storyboard frames from text prompts
Keeping a record of approved script and board versions
Exporting timings to Premiere, Resolve or After Effects
summary.what_it_does: Boords lets teams write scripts, build storyboards and create animatics in one place. Clients can review boards through a link without logging in and comment on specific frames. Versions can be marked Approved so the team works from the signed-off board. Users can save characters, products and locations to an asset library and reuse them in AI-generated frames via @ mentions, and refine a single frame while keeping earlier revisions. Boards can be turned into timed animatics with voiceover and exported as PDF, Slides, MP4, or timelines for After Effects, Premiere and Resolve.
notable: Client review by share link with no login, comments on exact frames, and version approval
Asset library with @ mentions to keep characters and props consistent across AI-generated frames
Timed animatics with voiceover, exported to Premiere, Resolve and After Effects
AI connections and Slack DMs included on every plan, including Free
caveats: Page does not state paid plan prices or limits; free tier described as 'Try Boords Free' with no card needed
Some share-link controls and exports are described without detail on which plans include them
